title: Hunan Bao Stuffed with Spinach and Crisp Vegetables
description: A fusion of Hunan flavors with the crispy goodness of bao. This recipe is a delightful twist on traditional Chinese cuisine.

ingredients.name: crisp vegetables (such as carrots, bell peppers)

instructions: 2. Roll out the bao dough and cut into 4 equal pieces.
3. Place 1/4 cup of chopped spinach on each piece of dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
4. Brush the edges with water and fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle.
5. Press the edges together to seal the bao and cut a small slit on the top to allow steam to escape.
6. Brush the tops with vegetable oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
7. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
8. Heat the Hunan sauce in a small pan over medium heat.
9. Add the crisp vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until tender.
10. Serve the bao with the Hunan sauce and crispy vegetables.
11. Garnish with additional chopped spinach if desired.
